Implemented `toggl entry invoice [--since <when>] [--until <when>]`.

It groups stopped, billable entries by project; rounds each entry to 15 minutes, applies the 30-minute floor, sorts by billed seconds then name, and prints the requested seconds-based summary. Unassigned entries use `No Project`; empty results print `(no data)`.

Key changes: [invoice.rs](/home/sandbox/workspace/src/commands/invoice.rs:13), [arguments.rs](/home/sandbox/workspace/src/arguments.rs:167), [main.rs](/home/sandbox/workspace/src/main.rs:259).

Verification: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -- -D warnings`, invoice-focused tests, and `cargo build` pass. `cargo test` has one unrelated existing failure: secure-storage initialization in `auth_status_shows_environment_source_when_token_in_env` (222 passed, 1 failed).

Now `--json`: `{"projects":[{"project":"Alpha","billable_seconds":4500}, ...],"total_billable_seconds":7200}`, same order as human, snake_case, integer seconds; empty window is `{"projects":[],"total_billable_seconds":0}`. Stdout is only the JSON document in JSON mode.

Then build and run the existing test suite. (`cargo test` also compiles tests/live_cli.rs, which needs real credentials to actually run — compiling is enough.)
